title: Rica Peralejo backs netizen’s call for QR codes on public funds

blocks.text: Rica Peralejo has backed calls for more transparency in government spending, questioning why taxpayers should not be able to track public funds as easily as they are now required to verify their tax registration. Peralejo reposted a Threads post from a netizen who criticized the Bureau of Internal Revenue’s (BIR) registration requirements for online sellers and digital earners. The original post read: “BIR wants taxpayers to be transparent? Geh san yung sainyo, we’d love to scan where our taxes go, we demand QR codes din for public funds lol.” “Ya bakit nga hindi natin idemand ito,” Peralejo wrote in the caption […]...
